annotations.title: Record goods received with no order

description: Stock that arrived with no purchase order behind it — the merchant bought it on the spot, or it was ordered outside the platform. Creates the order already fully received and ADDS THE QUANTITIES TO REAL STOCK at the outlet, in one step. Use this ONLY when no order exists. If the goods match an order that was sent, use receive_purchase_order instead — otherwise the same delivery is counted twice, once here and once when someone receives the real order. Check get_purchase_orders for an open order from this supplier before calling. The items must already be linked to the supplier (get_supplier_items) and stock-managed at the outlet. There is no undo: correcting a mistake means a stock adjustment afterwards.

customFees.description: Any other named charge on the order, e.g. "Handling"

discount.description: Flat discount on the whole order, e.g. "25.00". Not with discountPercent

discountPercent.description: Discount as a percentage of the items subtotal

dutyFees.description: Duty / customs charged on the order

discount.description: Flat discount on this line, e.g. "2.00". Not with discountPercent

discountPercent.description: Discount as a percentage of this line’s goods

feePerUnit.description: Extra cost per unit on this line

quantity.description: How many, in the unit the item is sold in. May be fractional for goods sold by weight or length

unitCost.description: Cost per unit the merchant pays, e.g. "12.50". Never cents, never the selling price

variantId.description: Item id from get_supplier_items — the supplier must carry it

outletId.description: Outlet id from get_outlets — where the goods physically arrived

receivedAt.description: ISO date the goods arrived — defaults to now

shippingFee.description: Shipping charged on the order, e.g. "18.00"

updateSupplierCostVariantIds.description: Items whose unitCost should become the supplier’s stored cost from now on
